title: Training Software Engineering Agents and Verifiers with SWE-Gym
authors_zh: Jiayi Pan、Xingyao Wang、Graham Neubig、Navdeep Jaitly、Heng Ji、Alane Suhr、Yizhe Zhang
paper_type_zh: 软件工程 agent 环境、轨迹数据与 outcome verifier 开放发布
best_for_zh: 研究 repository-level agent SFT、执行反馈、失败轨迹、outcome reward model、Best@k，以及容器、谱系、许可和版本漂移
one_line: SWE-Gym releases 2,438 unit-test-validated Python repository tasks plus OpenHands and Moatless trajectories, policies, and outcome verifiers built through rejection sampling and Best@k selection.
SWE-Gym 发布 2,438 个带仓库快照、容器环境和单元测试的 Python 工程任务，并把 491 条成功轨迹、5,564 条失败轨迹和 1,318/1,318 平衡 verifier 数据分开封装；但 Lite 数量、镜像 digest、轨迹谱系和各工件许可仍不一致。
why: It connects repository snapshots, tests, full agent episodes, success/failure selection, and learned trajectory rewards while exposing provenance, license, failure-retention, and image-pinning risks.
inclusion_reason: SWE-Gym is an open repository-agent recipe covering task sourcing, executable environments, unit-test validation, trajectory sampling, rejection-sampling SFT, balanced outcome-verifier training, and releases, with concrete lineage, license, failure-retention, and image-pinning risks.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The authoritative publication is the PMLR record and its 21-page final paper, published in Proceedings of the 42nd International Conference on Machine Learning, PMLR volume 267, in 2025. Repository-level software-engineering agents need more than issue text and a gold patch. Training requires a reproducible code snapshot, dependencies, an action interface, executable tests, and a success signal that can label complete interaction trajectories. SWE-Gym builds this substrate from real GitHub issues and pull requests.

The validated release contains 2,438 Python tasks from 11 repositories. Each task binds a natural-language issue to repo, base commit, version, human patch/test patch, and PASS_TO_PASS/FAIL_TO_PASS tests. This turns an issue into an environment-backed data object suitable for agent SFT, outcome-verifier training, and verifier-guided test-time selection.

The release is a family of separate objects, not one corpus: tasks, a Lite subset, Raw candidates, success-only SFT conversations, success/failure rollouts, verifier mixtures, Moatless data, models, forks, and Docker images. Their schemas, licenses, IDs, and revisions differ, so claims about openness must be made per artifact.

SWE-Gym belongs in Data Construction and Open Release Recipes because it covers the lifecycle from issue/PR extraction through semi-manual executable-environment setup, gold-patch test validation, trajectory sampling, success/failure filtering, SFT, outcome-verifier learning, Best@k selection, and multi-artifact release. It is not merely a repository-agent benchmark or a model leaderboard: the Atlas decision centers the construction and packaging contracts. No second category is needed for this Card.

The L4 evidence boundary is based on the venue-final paper plus inspected official code, task datasets, trajectory releases, model organization, environment/agent forks, and Docker surface. L4 does not certify safe reuse. The 64,689-to-2,438 rejection ledger, task-to-image digest/SBOM manifest, stable rollout-to-SFT/verifier lineage, several component licenses, semantic contamination audits, and count reconciliation remain unavailable.

权威出版入口是 PMLR record 及其 21 页终版论文，发表于 2025 年 Proceedings of the 42nd International Conference on Machine Learning，PMLR volume 267。Repository-level 软件工程 agent 需要的不只是 issue text 与 gold patch。训练还需要可复现代码快照、依赖、动作接口、可执行测试，以及能标注完整交互轨迹的成功信号。SWE-Gym 从真实 GitHub issue 与 pull request 构建这一 substrate。

验证后的版本包含来自 11 个仓库的 2,438 个 Python 任务。每个任务把自然语言 issue 与 repo、base commit、version、人工 patch/test patch 以及 PASS_TO_PASS/FAIL_TO_PASS 测试绑定起来，使 issue 成为可用于 agent SFT、outcome-verifier 训练和 verifier-guided test-time selection 的环境数据对象。

发布内容是一组分离工件，而不是单一语料：任务、Lite 子集、Raw 候选、success-only SFT 对话、成功/失败 rollout、verifier mixture、Moatless 数据、模型、fork 和 Docker image。它们的 schema、license、ID 与 revision 不同，因此开放性必须逐工件陈述。

SWE-Gym 属于“数据构建与开放发布配方”，因为它覆盖从 issue/PR extraction、半人工 executable-environment setup、gold-patch test validation、trajectory sampling、成功/失败过滤，到 SFT、outcome-verifier learning、Best@k selection 与多工件发布的生命周期。它不只是 repository-agent benchmark 或模型榜单；Atlas 的分类决策以构建与封装契约为中心。本 Card 不需要第二个 category。

这里的 L4 证据边界来自 venue-final paper，以及已检查的官方代码、任务数据、trajectory release、model organization、environment/agent fork 与 Docker surface。L4 不认证安全复用。64,689 到 2,438 的 rejection ledger、task-to-image digest/SBOM manifest、稳定的 rollout-to-SFT/verifier lineage、若干组件许可、semantic contamination audit 与数量差异协调仍不可用。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
SWE-Gym connects three feedback layers. First, semi-manually configured repository containers and expert-written unit tests define a programmatic environmental terminal predicate. Second, successful agent episodes become rejection-sampling SFT data. Third, balanced successful and failed episodes train outcome reward models whose success probabilities rank multiple candidate trajectories with Best@k.

OpenHands provides a general CodeActAgent trajectory with terminal and file-editing actions; MoatlessTools provides a constrained multi-stage workflow. Both learn by filtered behavior cloning rather than online RL. The accepted training_use values therefore remain SFT, reward modeling, agent training, and test-time compute; RLVR is not added.

The construction makes failures useful when they are retained. The 491-row SFT export is success-only, while a separate sampled release preserves the same 491 successes plus 5,564 failures. A different 2,636-row verifier mixture is exactly balanced at 1,318 success and 1,318 failure.

SWE-Gym 连接三层反馈。第一，半人工配置的仓库容器与专家编写单元测试定义程序化、环境化的终局谓词。第二，成功 agent episode 成为 rejection-sampling SFT 数据。第三，平衡的成功/失败 episode 训练 outcome reward model，其成功概率通过 Best@k 排序多个候选轨迹。

OpenHands 提供带 terminal 与文件编辑动作的通用 CodeActAgent 轨迹；MoatlessTools 提供受约束的多阶段 workflow。二者都采用 filtered behavior cloning，而不是 online RL。因此 accepted training_use 仅保留 SFT、reward modeling、agent training 与 test-time compute，不增加 RLVR。

失败在被保留时才具有数据价值。491 行 SFT export 只有成功样本；单独的 sampled release 保存同样的 491 个成功和 5,564 个失败。另一个 2,636 行 verifier mixture 则精确平衡为 1,318 个成功与 1,318 个失败。

title: Method
方法
html:
Task construction begins with 64,689 extracted issue/PR instances from 358 Python repositories. Eleven repositories receive semi-manual version and dependency configuration using repository files, CI, requirements, and documentation. A candidate environment is retained only when the human gold patch passes more unit tests than the original state, leaving 2,438 validated tasks. The rejected environment-construction ledger is not public.

The main row stores issue text, repo, base_commit, version, gold patch, test patch, and pass-to-pass/fail-to-pass lists. The PMLR paper and current Hugging Face Lite card contain 230 Lite tasks; the top-level README says 234, which is documentation drift rather than a second supported split. Main and Lite both expose train-style data, not held-out SWE-Gym evaluation splits.

OpenHands teacher trajectories come from gpt-4o-2024-08-06 and claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022 across multiple temperatures and 30/50-turn budgets. Test-passing episodes produce 491 SFT conversations. The sampled trajectory repository separately exposes 6,055 rows with messages, tools, patch, test output, flags, and outcome: 491 success and 5,564 failure.

OpenHands policy models are Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct 7B/14B/32B trained with full SFT. A reported attempt to mix on-policy self-improvement data with the 491 off-policy successes reduced held-out performance, so self-improvement is not presented as uniformly beneficial. Moatless samples 30 trajectories per Lite task at temperature 1.0 for two iterations, keeps successes, caps two per task, and prefers fewer rounds.

The OpenHands outcome verifier consumes problem statement, interleaved observations/actions, and current diff, predicts YES/NO, and uses normalized YES probability as scalar reward. Its current mixture has 1,318 positives and 1,318 negatives. At inference, up to 16 OpenHands or 8 Moatless candidates are sampled and the maximum verifier score selects Best@k.

Task images are named with mutable latest tags. GitHub repositories have no tags/releases, and no manifest binds all 2,438 rows to image digests, harness/scaffold commits, dependencies, test bundles, trajectory IDs, subset membership, model checkpoints, and artifact licenses.

任务构建从 358 个 Python 仓库中抽取的 64,689 个 issue/PR 实例开始。对其中 11 个仓库，根据仓库文件、CI、requirements 与文档半人工配置 version 和 dependency。只有当人工 gold patch 比原始状态通过更多单元测试时，候选环境才被保留，最终得到 2,438 个验证任务。环境构建的拒绝账本未公开。

主数据行保存 issue text、repo、base_commit、version、gold patch、test patch，以及 pass-to-pass/fail-to-pass 列表。PMLR 论文与当前 Hugging Face Lite card 都是 230 个任务；顶层 README 写 234，属于文档漂移，不是第二个有证据支持的 split。Main 与 Lite 都是 train-style 数据，不是 held-out SWE-Gym evaluation split。

OpenHands teacher trajectory 来自 gpt-4o-2024-08-06 与 claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022，混合多个 temperature 和 30/50-turn budget。通过测试的 episode 生成 491 条 SFT 对话。单独的 sampled trajectory repository 公开 6,055 条，包含 messages、tools、patch、test output、flags 与 outcome：491 个成功、5,564 个失败。

OpenHands policy 使用 Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct 7B/14B/32B 做 full SFT。论文报告把 on-policy self-improvement 数据与 491 个 off-policy success 混合后，held-out performance 下降，因此不能把自提升描述为普遍有效。Moatless 在两次迭代中，每个 Lite task 以 temperature 1.0 采样 30 条轨迹，保留成功，单题最多两条，并偏好更少轮次。

OpenHands outcome verifier 接收 problem statement、交错 observation/action 和 current diff，预测 YES/NO，并把归一化 YES probability 作为 scalar reward。当前 mixture 有 1,318 个正例与 1,318 个负例。推理时最多采样 16 条 OpenHands 或 8 条 Moatless 候选，由最高 verifier score 选择 Best@k。

Task image 使用可变 latest tag。GitHub 仓库没有 tag/release，也没有 manifest 将全部 2,438 行绑定到 image digest、harness/scaffold commit、dependency、test bundle、trajectory ID、subset membership、model checkpoint 与工件许可。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official PMLR record reports 2,438 tasks and ICML 2025 publication. Fine-tuning the OpenHands 32B agent on 491 successful trajectories raises SWE-Bench Lite and Verified resolution to 15.3% and 20.6%, absolute gains of 12.3 and 13.6 points over the stated baseline. These results demonstrate utility of the reported environment and SFT setup, not correctness of every task or license completeness.

Verifier-guided inference reports 32.0% on SWE-Bench Verified and 26.0% on Lite. Increasing candidate count shows roughly log-linear gains in the tested range, but Best@k remains below Pass@k: the learned verifier does not always select an available successful patch.

The paper also supplies negative evidence. Mixing 868 reported on-policy successes with 491 off-policy successes reduces OpenHands Lite performance from 15.3% to 8.7%. Moatless 32B plateaus after one iteration. These results warn that success-filtered self-improvement can amplify task-selection and distribution bias.

Unit tests are executable feedback, not a semantic proof. Incomplete, flaky, or exploitable tests can accept wrong patches or reject correct ones. No released audit quantifies test or learned-verifier false positives, false negatives, nondeterminism, or reward hacking.

PMLR 官方记录确认 2,438 个任务与 ICML 2025 发表。用 491 条成功轨迹微调 OpenHands 32B agent 后，SWE-Bench Lite 与 Verified resolution 分别达到 15.3% 和 20.6%，相对报告 baseline 绝对提升 12.3 与 13.6 个百分点。这说明报告的环境和 SFT 设置具有实用性，不能证明每个任务正确或许可完整。

Verifier-guided inference 在 SWE-Bench Verified 报告 32.0%，Lite 报告 26.0%。候选数量增加时，在受测范围内结果近似 log-linear 提升，但 Best@k 仍低于 Pass@k，说明 learned verifier 并不总能选中已经存在的成功 patch。

论文还给出负面证据。把 868 个报告的 on-policy success 与 491 个 off-policy success 混合，会使 OpenHands Lite performance 从 15.3% 降至 8.7%。Moatless 32B 在一次迭代后饱和。这说明 success-filtered self-improvement 可能放大任务选择与分布偏差。

单元测试是可执行反馈，不是语义证明。不完整、不稳定或可被利用的测试可能接受错误 patch 或拒绝正确 patch。公开版本没有量化测试或 learned verifier 的 false positive、false negative、nondeterminism 与 reward hacking。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
SWE-Gym's contribution is to turn real repository issues into reusable training environments rather than static issue-patch pairs. It combines snapshot identity, dependencies, tests, action trajectories, terminal outcomes, agent fine-tuning, outcome-verifier learning, and inference-time candidate selection in one recipe.

The release distinguishes policy data from verifier data. Successful episodes become behavior-cloning targets; failed episodes remain available in a separate sampled corpus and balanced reward-model mixture. This supports both learning what actions to imitate and learning which complete trajectories are likely to resolve a task.

The novelty is environment-backed data lifecycle integration, not a new unit-test concept or online RL algorithm. Repository-level tests remain imperfect, and rejection-sampling SFT remains supervised filtered learning. The value for this track lies equally in the open artifacts and the visible gaps between tasks, images, trajectories, models, licenses, and manifests.

SWE-Gym 的贡献是把真实仓库 issue 转化为可复用训练环境，而不是静态 issue-patch pair。它在一条配方中连接 snapshot identity、dependency、test、action trajectory、terminal outcome、agent fine-tuning、outcome-verifier learning 与 inference-time candidate selection。

发布内容区分 policy data 与 verifier data。成功 episode 成为 behavior-cloning target；失败 episode 保存在单独 sampled corpus 与平衡 reward-model mixture 中。这样既能学习应模仿的动作，也能学习哪些完整轨迹更可能解决任务。

新意是 environment-backed data lifecycle integration，而不是新单元测试概念或 online RL 算法。Repository-level test 仍不完美，rejection-sampling SFT 仍是监督式过滤学习。对本轨道而言，开放工件与 task、image、trajectory、model、license、manifest 之间的可见缺口同样重要。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The 64,689-to-2,438 environment funnel lacks a released rejection ledger. Lite count drifts between 230 in the venue-final paper/HF card and 234 in the README. Other surfaces disagree on 868 versus 875 on-policy successes and 5,557 versus the current 5,564 failures.

Lineage fragments across repositories. Main task rows preserve instance IDs and commits, but success-only SFT and reformatted verifier data drop explicit task/run columns. No release-wide manifest binds tasks to trajectories, tests, scaffold commits, checkpoints, or exact training subsets.

Reproduction depends on mutable infrastructure. Checked repositories have no tags/releases; documentation uses branch URLs; images use latest without a complete digest or SBOM list. One current digest is not a 2,438-image manifest. The repository-bundled paper is an older 18-page file, whereas PMLR and arXiv v2 provide the 21-page final paper and must control claims.

Licenses vary: paper CC BY 4.0, main code Apache-2.0, main data and OpenHands SFT MIT, while Lite, Raw, sampled/verifier/Moatless trajectories, checked models, and Docker images lack license metadata. No per-record ledger reconciles rights for upstream repositories, issues, patches, tests, and container layers.

Success-only SFT biases toward solvable tasks, unit tests can be gamed, and learned verifiers can misrank patches. Repository disjointness from SWE-Bench does not rule out semantic duplicates, code clones, or teacher memorization. Several released model repositories also lack cards, base-model/license declarations, and self-contained loading files.

从 64,689 到 2,438 的环境漏斗没有公开拒绝账本。Lite 数量在正式论文/HF card 的 230 与 README 的 234 之间漂移；其他界面还存在 868/875 个 on-policy success 以及 5,557/当前 5,564 个 failure 的差异。

谱系分散在多个 repository。主任务行保留 instance ID 与 commit，但 success-only SFT 和重新格式化的 verifier data 丢失显式 task/run column。没有 release-wide manifest 将任务绑定到 trajectory、test、scaffold commit、checkpoint 或精确 training subset。

复现依赖可变基础设施。核查仓库没有 tag/release，文档使用 branch URL，image 使用 latest，却没有完整 digest 或 SBOM 清单。一个当前 digest 不能替代 2,438 个 image 的 manifest。仓库 bundled paper 是旧 18 页版本；PMLR 与 arXiv v2 才是 21 页正式版，应作为事实依据。

许可不一致：论文 CC BY 4.0，主代码 Apache-2.0，主数据和 OpenHands SFT 为 MIT；Lite、Raw、sampled/verifier/Moatless trajectory、核查模型与 Docker image 则没有 license metadata。没有逐行账本协调上游仓库、issue、patch、test 与 container layer 的权利。

Success-only SFT 偏向可解任务，单元测试可能被利用，learned verifier 也会错误排序 patch。与 SWE-Bench 仓库分离不能排除语义重复、code clone 或 teacher memorization。若干模型仓库还缺少 model card、base-model/license 声明与可独立加载文件。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the Data Construction & Open Release Recipes track, SWE-Gym is a worked pipeline from issue sourcing through executable environments, trajectory sampling, success/failure retention, SFT, outcome-verifier training, and Best@k. Its separate success-only and failure-preserving releases are useful for studying how packaging changes the available learning signal.

Reuse should pin repo/base commits, harness and scaffold revisions, dependency locks, test bundles, image digests, dataset revisions, exact instance/trajectory IDs, and model checkpoints. A signed manifest should map each derived SFT/verifier row back to its sampled rollout and executable result.

Unit tests should be audited for flakiness, incompleteness, and exploitability; learned verifiers should report calibration and false selection rates. Failed environment builds and Moatless rejections should be retained with reason codes. Semantic issue/patch overlap and code-clone checks should supplement repository disjointness.

The task environments, sampled failures, and balanced verifier data are valuable for agent training and test-time selection within the accepted training_use scope. They are not license-complete or immutable by default, and reported benchmark gains do not certify task quality, model loadability, runtime reproducibility, or rights.

对“数据构建与开放发布配方”轨道而言，SWE-Gym 展示从 issue sourcing、可执行环境、trajectory sampling、成功/失败保留，到 SFT、outcome-verifier training 与 Best@k 的完整 pipeline。分离的 success-only 与 failure-preserving release 很适合研究封装方式如何改变可用学习信号。

复用时应固定 repo/base commit、harness 与 scaffold revision、dependency lock、test bundle、image digest、dataset revision、精确 instance/trajectory ID 与 model checkpoint。签名 manifest 应把每个派生 SFT/verifier 行映射回 sampled rollout 与执行结果。

单元测试应审计 flakiness、不完整性与可利用性；learned verifier 应报告 calibration 与错误选择率。失败环境构建与 Moatless rejection 应带 reason code 保留。语义 issue/patch overlap 与 code-clone 检查应补充 repository disjointness。

任务环境、sampled failure 与平衡 verifier data 在 accepted training_use 范围内适用于 agent training 与 test-time selection。它们默认并不具有完整许可或不可变绑定，报告的 benchmark 提升也不能认证任务质量、模型可加载性、运行时可复现性或权利完整性。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Use the official PMLR 21-page paper for claims; the repository's bundled PDF is an older 18-page version.
  • Keep 2,438 main tasks and the 230-task Lite subset separate; README's 234 is unresolved documentation drift.
  • Do not conflate the 491-row success-only SFT export with sampled trajectories containing 491 successes and 5,564 failures.
  • Verifier training uses an exactly balanced 1,318/1,318 mixture; outcome probability supports Best@k, not stepwise correctness.
  • Before reuse, reconcile artifact-specific licenses and pin every task to source, harness, trajectory, checkpoint, and Docker digest rather than mutable branches or latest.

• 事实陈述采用 PMLR 21 页正式论文；仓库 bundled PDF 是旧 18 页版本。
  • 区分 2,438 个主任务与 230 个 Lite 子集；README 的 234 属于未解决文档漂移。
  • 不要把 491 行 success-only SFT export 与包含 491 个成功、5,564 个失败的 sampled trajectory 混为一谈。
  • Verifier training 使用精确 1,318/1,318 平衡 mixture；outcome probability 用于 Best@k，不是 stepwise correctness。
  • 复用前协调逐工件 license，并把每个任务固定到 source、harness、trajectory、checkpoint 与 Docker digest，而不是可变 branch 或 latest。

版本说明：主代码检查于 commit b681068ca20628c6987b7416cc4cf03f06b77ba5，主数据检查于 revision bb94ed9e39bbeb96a7fcbfb533b80f25a7fd59cb。官方仓库没有与实验绑定的 tag 或 GitHub Release，也没有 immutable manifest 将 task ID、image digest、fork commit、trajectory、subset、checkpoint 与 prediction 绑定。工件存在并不意味着主代码/数据许可可自动转移到未标注许可的辅助发布。

value.html: Repository-level executable tasks plus state-action trajectories and trajectory-level success labels.

value_zh.html: 仓库级可执行任务，外加状态-动作轨迹与轨迹级成功标签。

value.html: Real GitHub issues and pull requests from 11 Python repositories selected from 358 candidates. Each task binds issue text to repo, base_commit, version, gold patch, test patch, and executable tests.

value_zh.html: 从 358 个候选中选出的 11 个 Python 仓库的真实 GitHub issue 与 pull requests。每个任务将 issue 文本绑定到 repo、base_commit、version、gold 补丁、测试补丁与可执行测试。

value.html: Task rows include issue text, human patch/test patch, repository snapshot, and PASS_TO_PASS/FAIL_TO_PASS tests. Sampled rollouts add messages, tools, generated patch, raw test output, evaluation flags, and resolved boolean.

value_zh.html: 任务行含 issue 文本、人工补丁/测试补丁、仓库快照与 PASS_TO_PASS/FAIL_TO_PASS 测试。采样 rollouts 增加 messages、tools、生成补丁、原始测试输出、评测标志与 resolved 布尔值。

value.html: OpenHands trajectories come from gpt-4o-2024-08-06, claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022, and fine-tuned Qwen2.5-Coder policies; MoatlessTools uses Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct 7B/32B policies.

value_zh.html: OpenHands 轨迹来自 gpt-4o-2024-08-06、claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022 与微调的 Qwen2.5-Coder 策略；MoatlessTools 使用 Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct 7B/32B 策略。

value.html: Per-task repository snapshots with semi-manually configured dependencies, unit-test harnesses, and Docker images. OpenHands exposes bash/file-editing actions; MoatlessTools uses a constrained multi-stage workflow.

value_zh.html: 带半人工配置依赖、单元测试 harnesses 与 Docker 镜像的逐任务仓库快照。OpenHands 暴露 bash/文件编辑动作；MoatlessTools 使用受约束的多阶段工作流。

value.html: Expert-written unit tests produce binary task outcomes. Outcome reward models trained on balanced successful/failed trajectories estimate success probability for Best@k selection.

value_zh.html: 专家撰写的单元测试产生二元任务结果。在平衡的成功/失败轨迹上训练的结果奖励模型估计成功概率，用于 Best@k 选择。

value.html: A patch resolves a task when it applies and satisfies required fail-to-pass and pass-to-pass tests; infrastructure/timeouts remain separate failures.

value_zh.html: 当补丁应用并满足所需 fail-to-pass 与 pass-to-pass 测试时，该补丁解决任务；基础设施/超时仍为单独失败。

value.html: Sampled OpenHands retains 5,564 failures separately from the 491-row success-only SFT export. Environment-construction failures and complete Moatless rejection decisions are not released as one ledger.

value_zh.html: 采样 OpenHands 将 5,564 次失败与 491 行仅成功 SFT 导出分开保留。环境构建失败与完整 Moatless 拒绝决定未作为一份账本发布。

value.html: Main tasks preserve repo/base_commit/version/instance_id, but SFT and reformatted verifier rows drop explicit task/run identifiers. Rows lack container digests, source licenses, and complete transformation manifests.

value_zh.html: 主任务保留 repo/base_commit/version/instance_id，但 SFT 与重格式化的验证器行丢弃显式任务/运行标识符。行缺少容器 digests、源许可与完整变换清单。

value.html: 2,438 validated tasks, 230 Lite tasks, 64,689 Raw tasks, 491 success-only OpenHands SFT rows, 6,055 sampled OpenHands trajectories with 491 successes and 5,564 failures, balanced verifier data, Moatless files, and weights.

value_zh.html: 2,438 个已核验任务、230 个 Lite 任务、64,689 个 Raw 任务、491 行仅成功 OpenHands SFT、6,055 条采样 OpenHands 轨迹含 491 次成功与 5,564 次失败、平衡验证器数据、Moatless 文件与权重。

value.html: Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct 7B/14B/32B for OpenHands and 7B/32B for MoatlessTools.

value_zh.html: OpenHands 使用 Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct 7B/14B/32B，MoatlessTools 使用 7B/32B。

value.html: OpenHands CodeActAgent 2.1 and the specialized MoatlessTools workflow; paper-run commit bindings are unknown.

value_zh.html: OpenHands CodeActAgent 2.1 与专用 MoatlessTools 工作流；论文运行 commit 绑定未知。

value.html: SWE-Bench-style extraction from real issues/PRs; 64,689 Raw tasks narrow to 11 repositories with executable environments.

value_zh.html: 从真实 issue/PRs 的 SWE-Bench 风格提取；64,689 个 Raw 任务收窄到 11 个带可执行环境的仓库。

value.html: OpenHands teacher sampling mixes GPT-4o temperatures and 30/50-turn budgets plus Claude temperature-0 runs. Moatless samples 30 trajectories per Lite task at temperature 1.0 in two iterations.

value_zh.html: OpenHands 教师采样混合 GPT-4o temperatures 与 30/50 轮预算，外加 Claude temperature-0 运行。Moatless 在两次迭代中以 temperature 1.0 为每个 Lite 任务采样 30 条轨迹。

value.html: SFT has 491 successes; sampled OpenHands has 6,055 trajectories. Verifier mixture has 2,636 rows, 1,318 success and 1,318 failure.

value_zh.html: SFT 有 491 次成功；采样 OpenHands 有 6,055 条轨迹。验证器混合物有 2,636 行，1,318 成功与 1,318 失败。

value.html: OpenHands uses multiple values from 0 to 1; Moatless uses 1.0; verifier-ranked evaluation uses 0.5 after an initial temperature-0 candidate.

value_zh.html: OpenHands 使用 0 到 1 的多个值；Moatless 使用 1.0；验证器排序评测在初始 temperature-0 候选之后使用 0.5。

value.html: SFT accepts execution-verified successes; inference selects maximum predicted success among k candidates.

value_zh.html: SFT 接受经执行核验的成功；推断在 k 个候选中选择预测成功最大者。

value.html: Retain environments whose gold patch improves test results. SFT retains test-passing rollouts. OpenHands verifier data balances successes/failures. Moatless keeps successes, at most two per task, preferring fewer rounds.

value_zh.html: 保留 gold 补丁改善测试结果的环境。SFT 保留通过测试的 rollouts。OpenHands 验证器数据平衡成功/失败。Moatless 保留成功，每任务至多两个，偏好更少轮次。

value.html: OpenHands ORM predicts YES/NO from issue, trajectory, and diff; normalized YES probability is the scalar reward.

value_zh.html: OpenHands ORM 从 issue、轨迹与 diff 预测 YES/NO；归一化 YES 概率是标量奖励。

value.html: OpenHands 30/50-turn sampling and up to 100-turn or 32k-context evaluation; Best@k uses up to 16 OpenHands or 8 Moatless candidates.

value_zh.html: OpenHands 30/50 轮采样以及至多 100 轮或 32k 上下文评测；Best@k 使用至多 16 个 OpenHands 或 8 个 Moatless 候选。

value.html: Rejection-sampling fine-tuning, not online RL. OpenHands policy uses full SFT; main verifier uses two-epoch LoRA. Moatless uses full 7B tuning and rank-64 LoRA for 32B.

value_zh.html: 拒绝采样微调，而非在线 RL。OpenHands 策略使用完整 SFT；主验证器使用两 epoch LoRA。Moatless 对 7B 使用完整微调，对 32B 使用 rank-64 LoRA。

value.html: 2,438 tasks from 11 Python repositories; Raw has 64,689 tasks from 358 repositories; rollouts mix proprietary teachers and Qwen policies.

value_zh.html: 来自 11 个 Python 仓库的 2,438 个任务；Raw 有来自 358 个仓库的 64,689 个任务；rollouts 混合专有教师与 Qwen 策略。

value.html: Main dataset is one 2,438-row train split; Lite is a 230-task subset, not validation/test; releases lack one immutable membership manifest.

value_zh.html: 主数据集是一个 2,438 行 train 划分；Lite 是 230 任务子集，而非 validation/test；发布缺少一份不可变成员关系清单。

value.html: Repository separation reduces direct overlap but does not address clones, semantic duplicates, or memorization.

value_zh.html: 仓库分离减少直接重叠，但不解决克隆、语义重复或记忆。

value.html: Repositories are disjoint from SWE-Bench, but semantic issue/patch overlap and teacher-pretraining exposure are unknown.

value_zh.html: 仓库与 SWE-Bench 不相交，但语义 issue/补丁重叠与教师预训练暴露未知。

value.html: SFT exposes 491 successes only; sampled data separately exposes the same 491 successes and 5,564 failures. Verifier failures lose explicit task/run columns; environment and Moatless rejection ledgers are incomplete.

value_zh.html: SFT 仅暴露 491 次成功；采样数据另行暴露相同的 491 次成功与 5,564 次失败。验证器失败丢失显式任务/运行列；环境与 Moatless 拒绝账本不完整。

items: Unit tests can be incomplete, flaky, or exploitable.
Learned verifiers can select false-positive patches; Best@k stays below Pass@k.
Repository disjointness does not rule out semantic duplication or memorization.
Code, datasets, trajectories, models, images, and upstream repositories have inconsistent licenses.
Mutable branches and latest images permit runtime drift.
Official surfaces disagree on Lite 230/234, on-policy 868/875, and failed rollouts 5,557/5,564.
Repository paper is an older 18-page PDF; PMLR/arXiv v2 are 21-page final versions.
Several model repositories lack cards, licenses, base metadata, or self-contained loading files.
单元测试可能不完整、不稳定或可被利用。
仅成功 SFT 过度加权可解/容易任务。
OpenHands 自我改进降低了留出表现。
习得验证器可能选择假阳性补丁；Best@k 仍低于 Pass@k。
仓库不相交并不排除语义重复或记忆。
代码、数据集、轨迹、模型、镜像与上游仓库的许可不一致。
可变 branches 与 latest 镜像允许运行时漂移。
官方表面在 Lite 230/234、on-policy 868/875 与失败 rollouts 5,557/5,564 上不一致。
仓库论文是较旧的 18 页 PDF；PMLR/arXiv v2 是 21 页终稿。
若干模型仓库缺少卡片、许可、基座元数据或自包含加载文件。

value.html: unknown

value_zh.html: 未知

value.html: Paper is CC BY 4.0; main code Apache-2.0; main dataset and OpenHands SFT MIT. Lite, Raw, sampled/verifier/Moatless trajectories, checked models, and images lack license metadata. No per-record upstream-rights ledger exists.

value_zh.html: 论文为 CC BY 4.0；主代码 Apache-2.0；主数据集与 OpenHands SFT 为 MIT。Lite、Raw、采样/验证器/Moatless 轨迹、已核验模型与镜像缺少许可元数据。不存在逐记录上游权利账本。

value.html: GitHub issue/PR -> environment setup -> gold-patch test validation -> 2,438 tasks -> rollouts -> execution labels -> success-only SFT or balanced verifier -> Best@k. Stable rollout mappings and image digests are incomplete.

value_zh.html: GitHub issue/PR -> 环境安装 -> gold 补丁测试核验 -> 2,438 个任务 -> rollouts -> 执行标签 -> 仅成功 SFT 或平衡验证器 -> Best@k。稳定 rollout 映射与镜像 digests 不完整。

value.html: Checked code/data/fork heads are pinned in the evidence ledger, but GitHub repositories expose no tags/releases. Documentation points to branches.

value_zh.html: 已核验的代码/数据/fork heads 钉扎在证据账本中，但 GitHub 仓库不暴露 tags/releases。文档指向 branches。
